IRON_TIP.name: Iron Tip
IRON_TIP.effect: MELEE ONLY: bypass 20% of enemy resistance.

BARBED_GLADIUS.name: Barbed Gladius
BARBED_GLADIUS.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies Bleed (2.0% HP/sec, 10s) on hit.

FIRE_OIL_FLASK.name: Fire Oil Flask
FIRE_OIL_FLASK.effect: RANGED ONLY: applies Burn (4% HP/sec, 3s) with 1-tile splash on impact.

POISONED_BLADE.name: Poisoned Blade
POISONED_BLADE.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies Poison (6% HP/sec, 4s) on hit.

CAVALRY_SPUR.name: Cavalry Spur
CAVALRY_SPUR.effect: MELEE ONLY: +30% attack speed, +0.5 tile range.

MERCURY_FEATHER.name: Mercury Feather
MERCURY_FEATHER.effect: Any tower: +22% attack speed. Universal speed boost — no class restriction.

CENTURIONS_TRUMPET.name: Centurion's Trumpet
CENTURIONS_TRUMPET.effect: Aura 2 tiles: allies gain +12% attack speed

TYRIAN_DYE.name: Tyrian Dye
TYRIAN_DYE.effect: MERCATOR EXCLUSIVE — +25% damage to Elites and Bosses.

SCIPIO_PLAYBOOK.name: Scipio's Playbook
SCIPIO_PLAYBOOK.effect: MERCATOR EXCLUSIVE — +20% damage to whichever enemy in range has the highest HP.

AQUILIFER_BANNER.name: Aquilifer's Banner
AQUILIFER_BANNER.effect: MERCATOR EXCLUSIVE — AURA 2.5 tiles: nearby towers +14% damage and +10% attack speed.

PUNIC_LEDGER.name: Punic Ledger
PUNIC_LEDGER.effect: MERCATOR EXCLUSIVE — Doubles kill-bonus accumulation rate (faster ramp to the +10% cap).

ALPHA_PACK_FANG.name: Alpha Pack Fang
ALPHA_PACK_FANG.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies heavy Bleed (2.4% HP/sec, 14s) on hit.

WAR_HOUND_COLLAR.name: War Hound Collar
WAR_HOUND_COLLAR.effect: Aura 2.5 tiles: allies gain +18% attack speed

FALCATA_BLADE.name: Falcata Blade
FALCATA_BLADE.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies hot Bleed (3.0% HP/sec, 8s) on hit. Front-loaded vs Alpha Pack Fang.

BARCA_WAR_HORN.name: Barca War Horn
BARCA_WAR_HORN.effect: Aura 3 tiles: allies gain +12% damage, +10% attack speed

CURSED_TORC.name: Cursed Torc
CURSED_TORC.effect: Aura 2 tiles: enemies in range take +18% damage from all sources

LICH_GENERALS_SEAL.name: Lich General's Seal
LICH_GENERALS_SEAL.effect: Aura 3 tiles: allies gain +12% damage, +15% attack speed

AQUILA_TALONS.name: Aquila Talons
AQUILA_TALONS.effect: MELEE ONLY: tower can target flyers in melee range.

SPEAR_OF_MARS.name: Spear of Mars
SPEAR_OF_MARS.effect: MELEE ONLY: +5 tile range. Tower throws a visible spear at every target.

JUPITERS_WRATH.name: Jupiter's Wrath
JUPITERS_WRATH.effect: Every attack arcs lightning to 3 nearby enemies (60% damage decay per jump) and stuns the primary 0.4s. Projectile sprite swaps to a thunder-bolt.

FALX_BLADE.name: Falx Blade
FALX_BLADE.effect: MELEE ONLY: grants CLEAVE. Each swing now hits EVERY enemy in melee range; secondary targets take 60% damage. Stacks with native cleave towers (Hastati, Triarius, Cohort Guard, etc.) by upgrading their cleave from 70% to 90% on secondaries.

VOLLEY_QUIVER.name: Volley Quiver
VOLLEY_QUIVER.effect: RANGED ONLY: +1 target per attack. A single-shot tower becomes dual-shot; an existing 2-shot becomes triple. Stacks additively on multi-shot combos (Decurion 2 → 3, Eques 3 → 4, Scorpion Bolt 3 → 4).

SIGIL_OF_SOL_INVICTUS.name: Sigil of Sol Invictus
SIGIL_OF_SOL_INVICTUS.effect: Any tower: +85% damage vs ALL Demon-faction enemies (Hellhounds, Fire Demons, Shadow Cavalry, Demon Legate, Daemon Imperator). Sun-god’s sigil burns the dark. Anti-Super-Demons specialist — carries W19/W20 endgame.

TYRANTS_LAUREL.name: Tyrant's Laurel
TYRANTS_LAUREL.effect: Any tower: +75% damage vs Bosses. The dedicated boss-hunter legendary — stacks multiplicatively with native boss bonuses (Primus Pilus, Scorpio, Triumphator). One per run.

VESTAL_PYRE.name: Vestal Pyre
VESTAL_PYRE.effect: Any tower: every attack applies BURN (5% maxHP/sec for 3s) on hit. Counts as a FIRE-damage source.

VENOM_TIPPED_ARROWS.name: Venom-Tipped Arrows
VENOM_TIPPED_ARROWS.effect: RANGED ONLY: applies POISON (5% maxHP/sec for 4s) on hit. The ranged-tower answer to Poisoned Blade — finally lets archers / scorpios / numidians stack a DoT.

SERPENT_AMULET.name: Serpent Amulet
SERPENT_AMULET.effect: Any tower: applies POISON (3% maxHP/sec for 5s) on hit. Gentler stack than Poisoned Blade but equips on ANY tower (melee or ranged).

WITCHS_VENOM.name: Witch's Venom
WITCHS_VENOM.effect: Any tower: applies POISON (8% maxHP/sec for 5s) on hit. Heavy poison — the strongest non-Legendary DoT in the catalog. Pairs with bleed / burn items for tri-DoT stacks.

LICTOR_FASCES.name: Lictor's Fasces
LICTOR_FASCES.effect: Any tower: +18% damage, +1 tile range. The magistrate's ceremonial bundle — small bonus everywhere, none of it specialized.

AUXILIARY_SLING.name: Auxiliary Sling
AUXILIARY_SLING.effect: RANGED ONLY: +30% damage. The light skirmisher's lead bullet — sized for archers, scorpios, and ballista crews.

OPTIO_WHISTLE.name: Optio's Whistle
OPTIO_WHISTLE.effect: Aura 2 tiles: nearby allies gain +12% attack speed. The drill master's command — keeps every tower in his hearing range a half-step quicker.

PRAETORIAN_COIN.name: Praetorian Coin
PRAETORIAN_COIN.effect: GATE-SHOP EXCLUSIVE: +1 Gold per kill. The same minted bronze the Praetorian Guard kept in their belt pouches — a small economic edge for the early game.

BRONZE_GREAVES.name: Bronze Greaves
BRONZE_GREAVES.effect: GATE-SHOP EXCLUSIVE: +0.5 tile range. Bronze leg armor lets a tower step half a pace further into the lane without breaking line.

RUSTED_HASTA.name: Rusted Hasta
RUSTED_HASTA.effect: GATE-SHOP EXCLUSIVE: Any tower: +10% damage. Old spear — chips, doesn't shatter.

AUGUR_SCROLL.name: Augur's Scroll
AUGUR_SCROLL.effect: GATE-SHOP EXCLUSIVE: Any tower: +12% attack speed. The augur read the birds and reported favorable signs — tempo bonus for the patient tower.

CONSULAR_TOKEN.name: Consular Token
CONSULAR_TOKEN.effect: GATE-SHOP EXCLUSIVE: Any tower: +8% damage, +0.5 tile range. Lead seal of consular authority — small bonus to two stats at once.

VANGUARD_PILUM.name: Vanguard Pilum
VANGUARD_PILUM.effect: INVASION REWARD ONLY: Any tower: +35% damage, +1 tile range. Roman frontier issue — recovered from the breach.

AQUILA_RAMPART.name: Aquila Rampart
AQUILA_RAMPART.effect: INVASION REWARD ONLY: Any tower: +50% damage vs enemies above 70% HP. Front-line execute — finish the breach early before they spread.

PERIMETER_TORCH.name: Perimeter Torch
PERIMETER_TORCH.effect: INVASION REWARD ONLY: Any tower: +25% damage AND +25% attack speed. The torch carried through the broken gate.

GRAVEKEEPERS_SCYTHE.name: Gravekeeper's Scythe
GRAVEKEEPERS_SCYTHE.effect: UPRISING REWARD ONLY: Any tower: +60% damage vs Undead-faction enemies (Undead Celts, Undead Carthage, reanimated forms). Bone breaks easy.

SOULFIRE_BRAND.name: Soulfire Brand
SOULFIRE_BRAND.effect: UPRISING REWARD ONLY: Any tower: applies HELLFIRE on hit (4% maxHP/sec for 4s) — true damage that ignores every resist and immunity. Divine fire from the urns.

NECROMANCERS_LANTERN.name: Necromancer's Lantern
NECROMANCERS_LANTERN.effect: UPRISING REWARD ONLY: Aura 3 tiles: enemies in range take +25% damage from all sources AND cannot regenerate. The lantern that drowns the dead.

HELLGATE_BRAND.name: Hellgate Brand
HELLGATE_BRAND.effect: GATES OF HELL REWARD ONLY: Any tower: +50% damage, +25% attack speed, immune to silence/tower-slow auras. Forged in the gates themselves.

DEMONSWORN_CROWN.name: Demonsworn Crown
DEMONSWORN_CROWN.effect: GATES OF HELL REWARD ONLY: Any tower: +100% damage vs Demon-faction enemies AND +50% damage vs Bosses. The crown that judges hellspawn.

INFERNO_STANDARD.name: Inferno Standard
INFERNO_STANDARD.effect: GATES OF HELL REWARD ONLY: Aura 3 tiles: nearby allies gain +25% damage AND every attack applies BURN (5% maxHP/sec for 3s) on hit.
